<!-- lang:zh -->
### ✨ 新增
- **状态栏与控制中心**：统一图标调节页面，提供原生、堆叠和 Duo 三种信号样式；支持网络类型字号与字重、堆叠信号左右布局，以及 Duo 展开控制中心后的独立信号样式。
- **SIM 卡与运营商**：按卡选择仅隐藏状态栏图标或全部隐藏；可独立隐藏原版控制中心的运营商整行，包括 HD 标记，并分别设置控制中心、通知中心和锁屏的飞行模式字样或图标。
- **锁屏与时钟**：支持左置图标与运营商标签切换、亮屏时短暂展示运营商、状态栏时钟常驻秒钟，以及 iOS 风格的旋转锁定图标。
- **返回手势**：同步 MiuiBackGestureHook 0.13.0，新增默认关闭的状态栏跟随和返回桌面图标动画预览；支持检测独立上游模块并避让冲突。
- **桌面**：Dock 改用桌面原生玻璃，支持几何调节和按图标数量自适应宽度；新增桌面行列、图标大小与颜色调节、大文件夹层叠预览、安卓小组件堆叠和最近任务卡片切换震动。
- **超级岛**：新增下拉展开内容时的拉伸与模糊效果，以及收起后继续播放倒计时、秒表等动态图标的选项。
- **通知与音量**：新增悬浮通知批量设置、横幅通知小窗手势白名单调整、所有应用弹幕通知、磁贴状态提示时长，以及独立的亮度/音量百分比与弹出样式设置。
- **系统框架**：扩展包管理安装与更新选项；普通应用共享 UID 与系统/特权共享 UID 分开控制，默认关闭，系统共享 UID 需额外确认。支持分别恢复原生照片与文件选择器，并调整小白条在桌面、最近任务和上滑过渡中的行为。
- **安全中心**：新增应用详情信息、点击图标启动应用、带应用名与版本的 APK 分享及更多应用禁用入口；扩展侧边栏固定/预测应用数量、提示线模式、准星与连招工具和游戏/杜比提示控制。
- **WLAN 与系统设置**：支持 IP 地址分行复制、已保存网络分享和查看密码、入口位置调整，以及澎湃 AI 页面入口和更多小窗启动场景设置。
- **净化**：新增应用商店广告与底栏控制、小米社区反馈条目过滤与反馈机型修改、营业厅推荐屏蔽，以及 SystemHelper 和 SmartDNS/双栈 DNS 控制。
- **工具与诊断**：新增设备信息页、LSPosed 桌面快捷方式、限时 Root 设置接口和本地诊断包；无线 ADB 支持 Wi-Fi 绑定、端口设置及系统 TLS 配对。
- **截图与分享**：支持调整安全内容截屏限制、截图剪贴板行为和保存目录，并显示原生分享面板中的更多分享目标。

### 🔧 修复
- 修复关闭三岛布局、切换设置或旋转屏幕后原生超级岛消失；改善模板宽度、计时文字、进度刷新和展开/收起动画衔接。
- 修复状态栏、锁屏、AOD 与控制中心之间的图标遮罩、SIM 隐藏、信号与网络类型交接、主题颜色及运营商布局；改善图标设置实时更新和热重载后的状态恢复。
- 修复返回手势连续滑动时的状态栏跟随、桌面与最近任务交接，并在移除独立上游模块后恢复本模块功能。
- 修复新版桌面的图标配色、网格与大小调节适配，以及配色切换时的崩溃和 Dock 重复重建卡顿；配色目标按原生调用和数据关系解析，桌面图标大小上限调整为实际有效的 150%。
- 修复通行密钥提供方开关在列表重新绑定时被误改，以及 FCM 相关 GMS 网络状态在热重载后未恢复的问题。
- 修复异签名同包更新的权限重复声明、原生安装器恢复、自动深色模式刷新和省电设置实时更新问题。
- 改善输入法样式与预测性返回、默认浏览器跳转和气泡文字强调、下载日志清理及通知栏时钟长按手势。
- 改善设置备份校验、更新检查与下载元数据一致性；减少重复扫描、反射、信号绘制及空闲线程工作，并修复热重载后的接收器与资源残留。

### ⚙️ 调整
- 仅维护 HyperOS 4 / Android 17；仍允许安装到 Android 16，但不提供其功能适配与验证。
- 移除独立 Quick Share 调整项及 Google Play 服务推荐作用域。
- 移除返回手势触发区域高度与位置调节，改用系统原生全高度区域。

### 已知限制
- 原生图标配色依赖应用提供的单色素材；未适配应用保留原色，部分素材可能出现黑块或主体偏小。

<!-- lang:en -->
### ✨ Features
- **Status bar and Control Center**: unify icon settings with native, stacked, and Duo signal styles; add network-type size and weight, stacked signal positioning, and an independent expanded Control Center signal style for Duo.
- **SIM and carrier controls**: choose status-bar-only or full hiding per SIM; independently hide entire native Control Center carrier rows, including HD badges, and configure airplane-mode labels or glyphs separately for Control Center, notifications, and the lockscreen.
- **Lockscreen and clock**: switch between left-side icons and carrier labels, briefly show the carrier on screen-on, display persistent clock seconds, and add an iOS-style rotation-lock icon.
- **Back gestures**: sync MiuiBackGestureHook 0.13.0, add optional status-bar following and Home icon animation previews, both off by default, and detect the standalone upstream module to avoid conflicts.
- **Launcher**: replace the Dock background with native Launcher glass, with geometry controls and adaptive width; add desktop grid, icon size and color controls, stacked large-folder previews, Android widget stacks, and Recents card haptics.
- **Super Island**: add stretch and blur effects while pulling down expanded content, plus an option to keep timer and stopwatch icons animated after collapse.
- **Notifications and volume**: add batch heads-up settings, banner mini-window whitelist controls, barrage notifications for all apps, tile message duration, and separate brightness/volume percentage and popup-style controls.
- **System framework**: expand package installation and update controls; separate ordinary shared UID from system/privileged shared UID options, both off by default, with extra confirmation for system shared UID. Independently restore native photo and file pickers, and control gesture-bar behavior on Home, in Recents, and during swipe-up transitions.
- **Security Center**: add app details, icon-to-launch actions, APK sharing with app names and versions, and more app-disable entries; expand sidebar pinned/predicted app limits, handle modes, crosshair and macro tools, and game/Dolby popup controls.
- **WLAN and Settings**: add per-address IP copying, saved-network sharing and password viewing, entry placement, HyperOS AI page entries, and more freeform launch scenarios.
- **Purification**: add App Store ad and tab controls, Xiaomi Community feedback-entry filtering and feedback model overrides, Business Hall recommendation blocking, and SystemHelper and SmartDNS/dual-stack DNS controls.
- **Tools and diagnostics**: add device information, an LSPosed desktop shortcut, time-limited root settings access, and local diagnostic bundles; wireless ADB gains Wi-Fi binding, port settings, and system TLS pairing.
- **Screenshots and sharing**: add secure-content capture controls, screenshot clipboard and save-location options, and more targets in the native share panel.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Fix native Super Island disappearing after disabling the three-island layout, changing settings, or rotating; improve template widths, timer text, progress refresh, and expand/collapse handoffs.
- Fix icon masking, SIM hiding, signal and network-type handoffs, theme colors, and carrier layouts across the status bar, lockscreen, AOD, and Control Center; improve live icon settings and state recovery after hot reload.
- Fix status-bar following during repeated back gestures and Home/Recents handoffs, and restore this module's gestures after removing the standalone upstream module.
- Adapt icon colors, grid, and size controls to newer Launcher builds; fix crashes and repeated Dock rebuilds when switching icon styles, resolve color targets from native call and data relationships, and limit desktop icon sizing to the effective maximum of 150%.
- Fix passkey provider switches changing during list rebinding, and restore FCM-related GMS network state after hot reload.
- Fix same-package permission redeclaration during differently signed updates, native installer restoration, automatic dark-mode refresh, and live power-saving settings.
- Improve keyboard styling and predictive back, default-browser routing and bubble highlights, download log cleanup, and shade gestures during clock long presses.
- Improve backup validation and update/download metadata consistency; reduce repeated scans, reflection, signal rendering, and idle worker activity, and fix receiver and resource retention after hot reload.

### ⚙️ Changes
- Only HyperOS 4 / Android 17 is maintained. Installation on Android 16 remains possible, without feature adaptation or validation.
- Remove the standalone Quick Share tweak and Google Play services from the recommended scope.
- Remove back-gesture trigger height and position controls in favor of the native full-height region.

### Known limitations
- Native icon colors depend on monochrome assets supplied by each app. Unsupported apps retain their original colors; some assets may render as black blocks or with smaller foregrounds.
